headline: Motion found Central Cemetery Tomb House application met Out of Cycle criteria; Girdler House MOU extension continued.
summary: Members discussed the Lynch Park sea wall project and the Girdler House generator, which they said differs from the original approved scope. They found the Central Cemetery Tomb House application met Out of Cycle criteria and agreed to continue the Girdler House MOU extension. Members also reviewed the Independence Park 50% status report and approved August 20, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Motion that the Central Cemetery Tomb House application meets Out of Cycle criteria carried 6-0-0 by roll call.
Agreed to continue the Girdler House MOU extension, hold the remaining approximately $7,000 of the $81,000 grant, and advise a new application.
Agreed the Independence Park 50% status report otherwise looks appropriate, with CPA acknowledgement to be included on the site.
Approved the August 20, 2026 meeting minutes as presented, carried 5-0-1 by roll call.

decision_evidence.quote: Marino: Motion that the application for the Central Cemetery meets the criteria for an Out of Cycle application. Buchsbaum seconds. Motion carries by roll call (6-0-0).

There was agreement on the Committee to continue with the MOU extension and continue to hold the approximately $7,000 while advising them to complete a new application and consider other funding possibilities for the project.
Pearl noted that appropriate CPA acknowledgement should be included on the site. The Committee agreed that the report otherwise looks appropriate.
Marino: Motion to approve the meeting minutes of August 20, 2026, as presented. Richter seconds. Motion carries by roll call (5-0-1).
